title: Chirality detection of two enantiomorphic 3D lanthanide coordination polymers by vibrational circular dichroism spectra

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: R enantiomorph of the dysprosium coordination polymer

synthesis.procedure: The article reports preparation from N-(2-hydroxyethyl)ethylenediamine-N,N′,N′-triacetic acid (H3L) and Dy(ClO4)3 in 10 mL deionized water. It refers to the ESI for further preparation details and does not specify how the R enantiomorph was isolated.

properties.summary: Single-crystal solid-state VCD distinguishes the R enantiomorph from 1b; no significant solid-state ECD signal was observed. Magnetic measurements are reported for compound 1 without specifying which enantiomorph was measured; the decreasing χMT on cooling and negative Weiss temperature suggest antiferromagnetic interactions and possibly magnetic anisotropy or ligand-field effects.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The R enantiomorph crystallizes in space group P4₁32. Alternating [DyL(H2O)] and [DyL(H2O)2] units form chiral helical chains; further Dy centers connect adjacent chains along three directions into a 3D network. Its helices are right-handed.
